body:
A `solace test` run inside a task is stopped after 10 minutes (E6012, `timed out after 600s`). That limit is right and stays as it is.

In task:52803ec35dce669f, run `c33314e7c8934805`, the first `solace test` in `solace-cli` hit that limit. The agent called it a cold compile, but cargo's log marked the dependencies as already built (`"fresh": true`), and the end of the log was cut off. So it isn't known whether the time went into compiling the `solace` crate, running its tests, or waiting on another cargo process.

Done when a `solace test` of `solace-cli` inside a task, on this machine (WSL2, 16 logical processors, 7.7 GB), finishes in under 10 minutes, and the summary says where the time went.
title: tests: a task's test run fits in 10 minutes
